## Upgrade And Bless Workflow

There’s no dedicated version-bump script. The pin lives in the workspace catalog; after updating it, use the repo’s `vp` tooling to refresh the lockfile.

The workflow commands are:

- `vp run -r build` materializes generated output; CI does this before its upstream check.

- Review the report, handle dropped-token/deprecation blockers in [formats/tokens/deprecations.json](formats/tokens/deprecations.json), then run `vp run upgrade:bless` and rerun `vp run upgrade:check`.
- `vp run sync:compatibility` regenerates [compatibility.json](compatibility.json) and [docs/compatibility.md](docs/compatibility.md); `vp run gate:compatibility` checks them.

These tasks are wired in [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts); `upgrade:check` and `upgrade:bless` both depend on `build:all`. The implementation and bless rules are in [tools/upstream-diff/index.ts](tools/upstream-diff/index.ts), with runner tests in [tools/upstream-diff/index.test.ts](tools/upstream-diff/index.test.ts) and pure diff tests in [tools/upstream-diff/lib.test.ts](tools/upstream-diff/lib.test.ts).

[docs/conventions/authoring.md](docs/conventions/authoring.md) calls for updating the guide, demo, drift-checked test, and public surface.
